title: One Confidence Threshold, Unequal Coverage: Language Gaps in Typed Decision Interfaces and How Translating Inputs Reduces Them
abstract: arXiv:2610.37688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deployed classifiers often act on a prediction only when its confidence clears a threshold and pass the rest to a person. We ask whether one threshold serves all languages equally on typed decision interfaces, APIs that return a probability for each option of a fixed multiple-choice question. In a confirmatory study with a written analysis plan, three vendors' interfaces classified 1,000 MASSIVE items, each in 51 languages, with a threshold of 0.9. Even when a request is answered correctly in both English and another language, the English version clears the threshold more often, by 8.6-11.7 percentage points on average. Observed coverage, the share of requests handled automatically, is lower than English's in every other language, while the requests the gate handles are rarely wrong. The gap remains when every language is reweighted to the same accuracy, and a standard calibration metric (ECE) does not detect it on one interface. In ex

translated_title: 同一置信度阈值，不平等的覆盖：类型化决策界面中的语言差距及翻译输入如何缩小差距
translated_abstract: 已部署的分类器通常只在预测置信度超过某个阈值时才自动执行预测，其余请求则转交人工处理。我们探究在类型化决策界面——即针对固定多项选择题的每个选项返回概率的API——上，同一阈值是否对所有语言同等有效。在一项有预先书面分析计划的验证性研究中，三家厂商的界面以0.9的阈值对1,000条MASSIVE数据（涵盖51种语言）进行了分类。即使同一请求在英语和另一种语言下都能得到正确回答，英语版本也更容易越过阈值，平均高出8.6至11.7个百分点。观测到的覆盖率（即被自动处理的请求占比）在其他所有语言中均低于英语，而阈值机制所放行的请求则很少出错。即使将所有语言重新加权至相同准确率，这一差距依然存在，且标准校准指标（期望校准误差ECE）在其中一家界面上无法检测到该差距。
tldr: 该研究通过对三家厂商类型化决策界面在51种语言上的大规模验证性实验发现，统一的0.9置信度阈值使英语请求的自动处理覆盖率平均比其他语言高出8.6-11.7个百分点，且该差距在同等准确率下依然存在、无法被标准校准指标检测到，而将输入翻译成英语可以缩小这一差距。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale confirmatory study of three vendors' typed decision interfaces across 51 languages, this paper shows that a single 0.9 confidence threshold gives English requests 8.6-11.7 percentage points higher automatic coverage than other languages—a gap that persists even at equal accuracy, goes undetected by standard calibration metrics, and can be reduced by translating inputs into English.
